data.creator_notes:
Tested with Opus 3, in theory the XML format should work well with OpenAI and local models, but I can't say I've tried it.

This character is one I use for stories and isn't natively in the best format for general chat use, but I'm working to adapt it. I have many in a similar style that I'd like to add as well. Feedback is welcome, otherwise enjoy. If you have any wishes for the character, feel free to reach out and if I can I will help you to do what you need with advice, additions, or a fork.

**Please send alternate starting messages if you write any, I don't use this format often so I don't generally have my own and will be slow to write more.**

The only real strength of this card compared to others is it's rather exhaustive XML definition (this can be adapted as a template!). Be aware that you are trading tokens for cohesiveness. **If you're using a model where context size is a big constraint, you'll want to change the format into something simpler, remove non-critical descriptions, or use a different character altogether.** If anyone has tricks for significantly reducing the token usage in this format, please let me know.
